title: SoftSeg: Advantages of soft versus binary training for image segmentation
mechanism: Train on non-binarised soft labels as regression (normalised ReLU output, regression loss) instead of classification.
adaptation: Crack channel regresses a blurred crack map (soft band) while other classes stay softmax; threshold chosen on val.
min_experiment: Arm SoftSeg crack head vs SUP100, 5 v 5. Kill if crack IoU < +0.012 or relP@2 drop > 0.05.
evidence: R: Dice +2.0% (gray matter), +3.3% (MS lesions), +6.5% (brain tumour) across random splits; higher sensitivity for small objects.
